# ClaimFilter { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter(
    timeline_id=None,
    timeline_ids=None,
    id_pattern=None,
    between=None,
    within=None,
    synchronous_only=False,
    nomatch_only=False,
    include_domains=None,
    include_units=None,
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
)
```

Reusable filter for querying MatchClaims and related objects.

All fields are optional. When multiple fields are set, they are combined
with AND logic: a claim must satisfy every non-None criterion.

The ``matches_claim()`` method tests a single MatchClaim against all
criteria; ``select()`` is its list form, asking the belief filter once
for the whole list. The ``matches_timeline()`` method tests a single
timeline ID (used to narrow the timelines of a stamp).

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Filter for claims involving a specific performer::

    f = ClaimFilter(id_pattern=r"^perf:")
    filtered = [c for c in claims if f.matches_claim(c)]

Filter for synchronous claims between score and one performer::

    f = ClaimFilter(
        between=("score:clt_1", "perf:dlt_1"),
        synchronous_only=True,
    )

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                    |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline_id      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | Return claims involving this exact timeline ID, on either side.                                                                                                                |
| timeline_ids     | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                                   | Return claims involving any of these timeline IDs, on either side.                                                                                                             |
| id_pattern       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | Regex pattern matched against timeline IDs via ``re.search()``; a claim passes when either of its timelines matches. Example: ``r"^perf:"`` matches all performance timelines. |
| between          | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None                                 | Return claims connecting exactly these two timelines (order-independent).                                                                                                      |
| within           | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                                   | Return claims whose both timelines are in this set.                                                                                                                            |
| synchronous_only | [bool](`bool`)                                                                         | If True, only synchronous claims (conceptual and NOMATCH claims excluded).                                                                                                     |
| nomatch_only     | [bool](`bool`)                                                                         | If True, only NOMATCH claims (one event, the sentinel on the other side).                                                                                                      |
| include_domains  | [set](`set`)\[[Domain](`timetoalign.core.enums.Domain`)\] \| None                      | Only claims whose both timelines are in these domains. Requires a ``timelines`` dict for resolution.                                                                           |
| include_units    | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None                  | Only claims whose both timelines have these units. Requires a ``timelines`` dict for resolution.                                                                               |
| believer         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | The actor whose beliefs filter claims (the belief filter); ``None`` filters nothing.                                                                                           |
| beliefs          | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\] | The states kept for the believer (``"true"``, ``"undecided"``, ``"unlikely"``, ``"false"``), held as a frozen set; default all but ``"false"``.                                |

### domain_unit_timeline_ids { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.domain_unit_timeline_ids }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.domain_unit_timeline_ids(timelines)
```

Resolve the domain/unit criteria into the set of ids that pass.

``include_domains`` / ``include_units`` are the only criteria that
need per-timeline metadata. Resolving them once into a plain set of
timeline ids lets a columnar store — which holds ids but no timeline
metadata — apply the same restriction vectorized.

The set carries the same semantics ``matches_claim`` applies: a claim
passes only when **both** of its timelines are in it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                                 | Description                                     | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timelines | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolution. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                 | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | ``None`` when neither criterion is set (no restriction), else the |
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | set of timeline ids satisfying both criteria (empty when          |
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | ``timelines`` is None, mirroring ``matches_claim``).              |

### matches_claim { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_claim }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_claim(claim, *, timelines=None)
```

Test whether a MatchClaim passes all filter criteria.

The belief filter compares actors under the context of the claim's
bundle (:func:`belief_context`).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| claim     | [MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)                              | The MatchClaim to test.                                                                                                                 | _required_ |
| timelines | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolving domain/unit filters. Required only when ``include_domains`` or ``include_units`` are set. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                           |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the claim passes all filters. |

### matches_timeline { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_timeline }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_timeline(timeline_id, *, timelines=None)
```

Test whether a single timeline ID passes the filter criteria.

Used to narrow the timelines of a stamp. Only the timeline-ID
related filters are applied (``timeline_id``, ``timeline_ids``,
``id_pattern``, ``within``, ``include_domains``, ``include_units``). The
claim-level filters (``synchronous_only``, ``nomatch_only``,
``between``, the belief filter) are ignored.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                 | Description                                                        | Default    |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                                         | The timeline ID to test.                                           | _required_ |
| timelines   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolving domain/unit filters. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                         |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the timeline passes all applicable filters. |

### select { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.select }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.select(claims, *, timelines=None, context=None)
```

Return the claims that pass every criterion, in their order.

The list form of :meth:`matches_claim`: the belief filter is asked
once for the whole list (:func:`believed`), then each claim's kind
and timelines are tested.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| claims    | [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)\] | The claims to filter.                                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| timelines | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None                 | Timeline ID -> object with a ``unit`` (a :class:`~timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`), for resolving domain/unit filters; a timeline missing from it passes neither. | `None`     |
| context   | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None                 | The JSON-LD context under which the believer and the actors compare as IRIs (:func:`belief_context`); ``None`` declares no prefix.                                | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                      | Description                                        |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)\] | The kept claims, the same objects, in their order. |
